empirical_result.statement: For all five torsion representatives of each of 128 first-layer new orbits, 166 eligible second-layer Hecke rows add 166 total rational rank but zero rank induced on the original 117 or first-layer 245 columns after all new columns are eliminated.

structural_theorem.conclusion: Old-only components of old plus new rows whose new-column component vanishes equal S.
structural_theorem.hypotheses: Additive groups O,N,W; old-only set S subset O; additive maps A:W to O and B:W to N; B injective.
structural_theorem.instance_bridge: The exact selected 166 by 166 new-column submatrix has rank 166 over Q, proving B injective for this finite row family; the matrix-to-Lean construction remains computationally checked.
